title: Liquid Cooler
subtitle: An image or animated GIF on your liquid cooler's screen.
showLabel: Show the image on the cooler
state.busy: Screen in use by another program
text.connected: The screen responded and your chosen image is being sent to it.
text.disabled: Turn on "Show on cooler" to send the image to the screen.
text.busy: The cooler was found, but another program is using the screen right now (usually ZEUS CAST, which stays open in the tray). Only one program can talk to the screen at a time: close the other one and click "Check again".
text.gone: The screen disappeared while Hydraflow was talking to it (cable moved or the cooler restarted). Hydraflow will try again on its own.
text.open: The cooler was found, but Windows didn't allow opening a connection to the screen.
text.no-response: The connection to the screen opened, but it didn't answer the handshake. Turn your PC off and on; if it keeps happening, plug the cooler's USB cable into another header.
text.protocol: The screen answered, but not in the way Hydraflow expected. It may be running firmware that hasn't been tested yet.
text.send: The screen was connected and stopped accepting images. Hydraflow will reconnect in a moment.
text.incompatible: Windows shows a Gamdias device, but a hardware revision Hydraflow doesn't know yet.
text.usb-error: The cooler screen's USB cable shows up as "unknown device (port reset failed)": the screen isn't talking to the PC, and no program can send images this way — not even ZEUS CAST. With the PC off, unplug and replug the cooler's USB cable into the motherboard's internal USB 2.0 header (or use another header), turn the PC on and click "Check again".
text.missing: No compatible screen is connected. Hydraflow currently talks to Gamdias screens (AURA GL360 LCD and CHIONE LCD). Check that the cooler's USB cable is plugged into an internal USB 2.0 header on the motherboard.
